name: What kind of paint is best for ceilings?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint is best for ceilings?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most ceilings, a flat or matte finish latex paint is recommended. These finishes help to hide minor imperfections, absorb light, and minimize glare, creating a smooth and uniform look. Low-VOC (volatile organic compound) paints are also a good choice for indoor air quality. In areas prone to moisture, like bathrooms, a mildew-resistant paint is preferable. Our team can advise on the best type of paint based on your specific ceiling condition and room usage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Flat or matte latex paint is generally best for ceilings to hide imperfections and reduce glare. Mildew-resistant options are good for high-moisture areas.
